description: Where each goal shows in My Goals on a day (decisions 12, 25, 26, 30 and 46), first match wins: History (ended in its document; completed by its completion policy; past its last day; or no scheduled day left), Paused (paused today), Tracking (trackers), Today (due today, or a missed day still pending make-up), Upcoming (with its next due day). Today, Tracking and Paused follow the user's goal_order, then goals it doesn't name by created_on and ID; Upcoming is by next due day, then that order; History is newest first, then that order.

hijri_corrections.description: The account's Hijri month-start corrections. Absent means none.

next_due.description: The next due day within 400 days, or null if pauses cover them all.

on.description: Its ended.on, or the day it was completed, or its last (scheduled) day.

cases.description: Due today; due Friday; a tracker; paused; ended by the user; a total reached on 11 October; past its end date.
Today follows the user's order; goals the order doesn't name follow, oldest first.
Unordered goals created the same day go by ID.
Upcoming is soonest first; the user's order breaks ties.
A Ramadan goal stays in Upcoming after Ramadan, with next Ramadan's first day.
A goal starting on 20 October waits in Upcoming.
A Friday goal with make-up within 3 days, Friday missed: on Sunday it isn't due, but it's in Today's goals so Friday can be made up (decision 46).
On Tuesday Friday's window has closed: the goal waits for next Friday.
A pause that starts tomorrow doesn't move it yet.
A pause that ended yesterday is over.
A paused tracker sits in Paused, not Tracking.
A Friday tracker is in Tracking on a Wednesday too.
A weekly total due every day is in Today's goals all week.
The document's ended decides: completed reads as completed, every other reason as ended.
A completed goal stays in History even if an adjustment took its total back below the target.
Reaching the total today moves it to History at once.
Today is the last day: still in Today's goals.
"For 10 days" with completion when the duration ends: completed on its last day.
Its dates are all past: finished on the last one.
Paused with no end: it stays in Paused.
History is newest first; the user's order breaks ties.
